'''Kitwarr''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[Silverback]] [[Wookiee]]<ref name="Spark" /> born in [[15 BBY]]<ref name="Age" /> and [[Slavery|enslaved]] by the [[Galactic Empire]] along with his father, [[Wullffwarro]]. He was forced to work in the [[Spice mines of Kessel|spice mines]] of [[Kessel]] until he and his fellow Wookiee slaves were [[Mission to free Wookiee prisoners|rescued]] by a small band of [[Spectres|rebels]] led by the [[Jedi]] [[Kanan Jarrus]]. Kitwarr was chased by a [[stormtrooper]], but [[Ezra Bridger]], a [[Force-sensitive]] human, came to his aid. The two were cornered on a catwalk by [[Agent]] [[Alexsandr Kallus|Kallus]], but they were able to escape soon afterwards aboard the ''[[Ghost]]''. Kitwarr was able to reunite with his father; they and the other liberated Wookiees were picked up by an [[Auzituck anti-slaver gunship|''Auzituck'' anti-slaver gunship]].<ref name="Spark" />
